sources.title: SQLite transactions
sources.version_context: Rolling official docs; no selected shipped build
sources.governing_context: One writer; DEFERRED does not immediately lock. Busy commit may remain active. Error rollback extent varies; autocommit/transaction-state APIs reveal it.
sources.operation: Independent public primary-source read; documentation/code/callers/tests were inspected, not executed.

sources.title: SQLite UPSERT
sources.governing_context: Uses declared uniqueness, not domain identity. Last conflict target can be omitted for DO UPDATE in 3.35.0+; virtual tables are excluded.
sources.operation: Independent public primary-source read; documentation/code/callers/tests were inspected, not executed.

sources.title: SQLite atomic commit
sources.governing_context: Rollback journal explanation is not WAL evidence. Storage/flush assumptions bound crash guarantees; a separate spool is not automatically covered.
sources.operation: Independent public primary-source read; documentation/code/callers/tests were inspected, not executed.

sources.title: SQLite WAL and reset history
sources.inspected_locator: Overview/ATTACH exception; §11 conditions and race sequence
sources.governing_context: Reset defect needs WAL, multiple connections and overlapping checkpoint/write timing. Cross-ATTACH WAL transactions are not atomic across the set.
sources.operation: Independent public primary-source read; documentation/code/callers/tests were inspected, not executed.

sources.title: SQLite synchronous settings
sources.governing_context: WAL NORMAL can lose acknowledged commits on system/power failure; FULL adds commit sync. Rollback EXTRA adds directory sync in DELETE mode.
sources.operation: Independent public primary-source read; documentation/code/callers/tests were inspected, not executed.

sources.title: SQLite isolation
sources.inspected_locator: Connection isolation, snapshots, write serialization, BEGIN IMMEDIATE
sources.governing_context: Writes serialize within transactions. A completed pre-transaction read does not protect a later write against an intervening committed writer.
sources.operation: Independent public primary-source read; documentation/code/callers/tests were inspected, not executed.

sources.title: rusqlite Transaction
sources.governing_context: Drop defaults to rollback but is configurable; explicit finish exposes errors. Wrapper behavior does not prove filesystem durability.
